from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import PresignedDownloadRequest, PresignedDownloadResponse

def generate_presigned_download_url(request: PresignedDownloadRequest) -> PresignedDownloadResponse:
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(request.blob_name)

    signed_url = blob.generate_signed_url(expiration=request.expiration_seconds)

    return PresignedDownloadResponse(signed_url=signed_url)

from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import ObjectMetadataRequest, ObjectMetadataResponse

def get_object_metadata(request: ObjectMetadataRequest) -> ObjectMetadataResponse:
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.get_blob(request.blob_name)

    if not blob:
        raise ValueError(f"Blob '{request.blob_name}' not found in bucket '{request.bucket_name}'.")

    return ObjectMetadataResponse(
        bucket_name=request.bucket_name,
        blob_name=request.blob_name,
        size=blob.size,
        content_type=blob.content_type,
        updated=blob.updated.isoformat() if blob.updated else None,
        metadata=blob.metadata
    )

from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import ListPrefixRequest, ListPrefixResponse

def list_objects_with_prefix(request: ListPrefixRequest) -> ListPrefixResponse:
    client = get_storage_client()
    
    blobs = client.list_blobs(
        request.bucket_name,
        prefix=request.prefix,
        max_results=request.max_results
    )

    blob_names = [blob.name for blob in blobs]

    return ListPrefixResponse(blob_names=blob_names)

from google.cloud import vision_v1p4beta1 as vision
from google.cloud import storage
from storage_models import ObjectMetadataRequest # Reusing for simplicity to identify the document
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

@dataclass
class StoredDocumentOcrRequest:
    bucket_name: str
    blob_name: str

@dataclass
class StoredDocumentOcrResponse:
    text: str
    full_response: Optional[dict] = None

def run_ocr_on_stored_document(request: StoredDocumentOcrRequest) -> StoredDocumentOcrResponse:
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    
    # Construct the GCS URI for the image
    gcs_source_uri = f"gs://{request.bucket_name}/{request.blob_name}"
    source = {'image_uri': gcs_source_uri}
    image = vision.Image(source=source)

    # Set the feature type to DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION for comprehensive OCR
    feature = vision.Feature(type_=vision.Feature.Type.DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION)

    # Perform the OCR request
    response = client.annotate_image({'image': image, 'features': [feature]})
    
    full_text_annotation = response.full_text_annotation
    text = full_text_annotation.text if full_text_annotation else ""

    return StoredDocumentOcrResponse(text=text, full_response=vision.AnnotateImageResponse.to_dict(response))

class StoredAssetSummaryRequest:
    text_content: str
    min_length: int = 50
    max_length: int = 200

@dataclass
class StoredAssetSummaryResponse:
    summary: str
    full_response: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

def summarize_stored_asset_content(request: StoredAssetSummaryRequest) -> StoredAssetSummaryResponse:
    # Initialize Vertex AI (you might want to move this to a central client helper if more Vertex AI calls are made)
    # For this example, assuming project and location are set up in environment or gcloud config
    vertexai.init()
    model = GenerativeModel("gemini-pro") # Using a concrete model identifier

    prompt = f"Summarize the following text, ensuring the summary is between {request.min_length} and {request.max_length} words:\n\n{request.text_content}"

    response = model.generate_content(
        prompt,
        generation_config={
            "max_output_tokens": 800,
            "temperature": 0.4,
            "top_p": 0.8,
            "top_k": 40
        },
        safety_settings=[] # Adjust as needed
    )

    summary_text = response.text

    return StoredAssetSummaryResponse(summary=summary_text, full_response=response.to_dict())
